metadata.remarks:
Identity Authorization defines the capability to evaluate policy and determine what authenticated identities are permitted to do. Authorization decisions are evaluated at access time and are independent of authentication strength.

Governance and Responsibility Anchor:
This pattern is the authoritative anchor for SSPPs, standards, procedures, and assurance activities related to authorization. Identity semantics are defined by Identity Core; authorization evaluates permissions, attributes, and context against policy.

components.title: Entitlement Model
components.description: Defines how permissions, roles, attributes, and relationships are represented to express authorization intent.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Unauthorized modification of permissions or entitlements.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Structured and governed representation of authorization intent.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Authorization based on managed identities and roles.
Least privilege enforced through entitlement modeling.

components.title: Delegation
components.description: Controls how one identity may delegate limited authority to another.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Abuse of delegated privileges to escalate access.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Separation of duties enforced in delegation.

components.title: Policy Decision
components.description: Evaluates authorization policies against identity attributes, entitlements, and contextual information.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Abuse of valid identities when authorization is overly permissive.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Authorized access enforced by policy decisions.
Authorization decisions recorded as audit events.

components.title: Enforcement Separation
components.description: Separates policy decision from enforcement to ensure consistent application of authorization.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Consistent enforcement of decisions via centralized policy.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Authorization policies centrally defined and enforced.
